# e2b_template_tags (Data Source)

Lists tags assigned to an E2B template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "e2b_template_tags" "production" {
  template_id = "tpl_123"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `template_id` (String) Template ID.

### Read-Only

- `tags` (Attributes List) Tags assigned to the template. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `build_id` (String) Template build ID associated with the tag.
- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the tag was created.
- `tag` (String) Template tag alias.
